objective: Select a richly compensated weekly short put and inexpensive protective put, with the option to stay in cash when estimated net compensation is inadequate.

universe.roll: Friday close or prior holiday session to following Friday PM expiration
universe.notional: 100% of current equity using SPX cash spot; fractional contracts

information_timing.market_indices: Prior SPX trading session closing SPX, VIX, VVIX, VIX3M indicators
information_timing.option_features: Entry snapshot bid/ask, IV, Greeks and recorded volume/open interest; same-EOD execution convention
information_timing.training_labels: Only trades expired strictly before the annual model refit cutoff
information_timing.holdout: 2024-01-01 through archive end; model families, feature sets, and entry thresholds frozen using earlier validation only

fitting.schedule: Expanding annual refits; candidates from each entry week stay in the same split
fitting.economic_forecast: 156 most recent matured weekly outcomes, minimum 104, scaled using lagged realized volatility; forecast both legs jointly
fitting.regression_target: Expected terminal spread liability as a fraction of strike width
fitting.sample_weight: Each entry week has total weight one regardless of available candidate count

feature_comparisons: Core structure/compensation, additions of each feature family, full model, and full model leaving each family out

policies.rank: Forecast net credit less expected spread liability divided by forecast liability risk with a floor
policies.risk_floor: max(10% of width as spot fraction, 0.0005)
policies.tie_break: Lower width, then lower short strike

selection.criterion: Highest validation daily marked Sharpe among policies with a positive-compensation gate, then validation CAGR; always-trade policies are controls; no holdout-based reselection
selection.iv_z_rule: Diagnostic only; a positive difference of leg IV z-scores is not a positive-compensation gate and is excluded from primary winner eligibility. Clarified before viewing validation results or fitting final-period models.
selection.finalists: One frozen winner for each width universe, fixed weekly 99/96, validation-best fixed 3%-wide spread, and economic-rule controls

reporting.headline_sharpe: Actual daily bid/ask midpoint NAV returns, annualized by sqrt(252), zero cash rate
reporting.cash_weeks: Zero option returns included on all trading days
reporting.uncertainty: Paired weekly block bootstrap on final-period strategies versus fixed 99/96
reporting.claim_limit: Exploratory feature research; improved performance is not promised
